Acceptance criterion: 03 is one intact printed piece: both thick lugs are complete, with no cracks or whitening at the stem or head.
The lock head is approximately 26 mm wide; it was imported in millimetres at 100% without automatic scaling.
01 remains one piece after removal and cleaning; ear roots, eye frames, ledges, lock receiver and feet are intact.
The complete module enters from behind with its original backplate and screws, without force or grinding the hardware.
Both active display areas are unobstructed, the glass clears the enclosure and the structural board rests on the ledges.
The original speaker lead reaches the lower pad naturally; adhesive contacts its complete rear housing and the sound face points rearward.
USB seats fully, the rigid strain relief stays straight and the flexible cable turns rearward naturally.
Without electronics, 02 seats along all four guides; 03 inserts horizontally, turns about 90° with light pressure and reverses for removal.
The locked cover cannot pull off. Nominal play is approximately 1 mm; stop if it noticeably exceeds approximately 1.5 mm or the cover tilts loose.
After 20 empty-enclosure cycles, the lugs, receiver and guides show no cracks, whitening or wear that affects retention.
With the actual board, speaker and cables installed, the cover still closes without pinching wires or pulling the short speaker lead when opened.
With power off, gently change orientation: the eye module stays retained without striking the glass. Investigate any slipping or unusual rattling.
With USB attached on the table, all four feet sit steadily and the flexible cable clears the table by at least 5 mm, without a hanging cable pulling on the port.
After power-on, both displays, supply, buttons, playback, capture and wake operation work normally.
After 60 minutes, there are no supply-related resets, unusual smells or abnormal heating. Touch alone does not establish compliance with component temperature specifications.
